item.title: Pints, Privacy & Peach IPAs
item.description:
Welcome to The Service Provider Arms — where every pint tells a story. Today’s tale? How VPNs work, told through the noble art of ordering beer.

You might already know what a VPN is — a Virtual Private Network — but if someone asked you to explain it in plain English, you’d probably wave your hand vaguely at the air and say “something to do with privacy.” That’s fair. The technology is genuinely useful but routinely explained like a GCSE textbook. So let’s fix that.

item.title: Pints, Packets & Protocols
item.description:
You use the internet every day — but have you ever stopped to wonder what’s actually happening when you type a web address and hit Enter? Routers, DNS, TCP, IP addresses… it can all sound pretty intimidating. So let’s forget the jargon for a moment and head to the pub instead.

In this post we’re going to walk through how the internet works, using the world’s biggest bar as our guide. By the time you’ve finished reading, you’ll understand what happens every time you visit a website — and you might even be thirsty.
